title: Implementation Specialist I
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
 About the Operations team
The Operations team delivers seamless customer experiences and enables new product capabilities while ensuring operational excellence. The team owns strategy, planning, technical execution, customer service, fraud operations, process design, quality, training, and program management. We drive efficiency, resolve issues quickly, and scale operations as the business grows. Our goal is to deliver seamless support while maintaining high standards and reducing risk.
 About the Role
As an Implementation Support Specialist I, you’ll combine your exceptional technical and communications skills to support the implementation of the Affirm solution with our growing network of retail partners. You will serve as a primary support contact for our partners’ business and technical teams throughout the integration process, while working cross-functionally with Affirm’s Engineering and Merchant Operations teams to help provide clients with quick solutions, troubleshoot account issues, and build internal processes that scale.
 What You'll Do
 Provide exemplary support to merchant partners on topics including: marketing best practices, accounting workflows, implementation guidance / troubleshooting
 Resolve technical integration issues related to partners’ ecommerce front-end platforms and back-end order management systems
 Identify and implement new operational processes to drive efficiency
 Develop detailed technical documentation
 Engage with internal stakeholders to define cross-functional workflows
 Provide product feedback from clients to the Product and Engineering teams to improve overall product performance and feature set
 What We Look For
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

title: Product Manager II, Wallets and DeFi
description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase .
 The Coinbase Developer Platform (CDP) is building crypto infrastructure at scale for any business, anywhere. As the Wallets PM, you will own the Flexible Custody roadmap serving fintechs, brokers, and corporates around their custody and DeFi needs.
 What you'll do:
 Own the Unified Custody roadmap end to end
 Define the product strategy for custody model optionality, so customers choose self-custody, custodial, or hybrid per use case without rebuilding integrations.
 Partner with engineering, security, legal, and compliance to launch custody and DeFi products that meet the institutional bar for key management, controls, and regulatory posture.
 Translate customer and launch-partner needs into a prioritized roadmap tied to assets-on-platform and revenue targets.
 Measure and grow adoption: AOP and revenue, with clear funnel metrics from integration to funded accounts.
 Required Skills and Experience:
 5+ years of product management experience shipping developer-facing or API-first products, ideally custody, wallets, or fintech infrastructure.
 Deep understanding of crypto custody models (self-custody, MPC, qualified custodian) and DeFi primitives (lending, vaults, onchain yield).
 Track record of shipping 0-to-1 products with engineering teams and taking them to production scale with enterprise customers.

title: Kundenberater / Kundenbetreuer für internationale Internatsaufenthalte
description:
Für unser neues Büro in Berlin-Frohnau (Reinickendorf) suchen wir dich als Kundenberater / Kundenbetreuer für internationale Internatsaufenthalte (m/w/d). Auch Quereinsteiger sind herzlich willkommen! Wir sind Akademis Internatsberatung, eine mehrfach ausgezeichnete Bildungsagentur. Wir helfen Familien, ein passendes Internat im Ausland zu finden, und begleiten sie vom ersten Gespräch bis zur Rückkehr ihres Kindes. Dabei teilen wir ihre Vorfreude, nehmen ihre Sorgen ernst und kümmern uns um die vielen kleinen und großen Fragen unterwegs. Eine Aufgabe, die dir am Herzen liegt Unsere Familien vertrauen uns eine wichtige Entscheidung an. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, dem gute Arbeit persönlich wichtig ist: Du möchtest Eltern und Jugendliche aufmerksam begleiten, hältst Zusagen ein und bleibst an offenen Anliegen dran. Auch bei den Details arbeitest du gewissenhaft – denn auf deine Auskünfte, Unterlagen und Absprachen sollen sich andere verlassen können. Wir wünschen uns jemanden, der die persönliche Zusammenarbeit in einem kleinen Team schätzt und selbst zu einer guten Atmosphäre beiträgt: mit Freundlichkeit, gegenseitiger Unterstützung und einem ehrlichen, respektvollen Umgang. Dafür stehen dir eine gründliche Einarbeitung und ein hilfsbereites Team zur Seite.
 Aufgaben Familien beraten und von Anfang bis Ende begleiten: Du lernst Eltern und Jugendliche kennen, berätst Interessierte zu unserem Angebot und betreust deine Familien während der Vorbereitung und des Internatsaufenthalts bis zur Rückkehr. Du hörst aufmerksam zu, gehst auf individuelle Wünsche ein und hältst von dir aus Kontakt – telefonisch und per E-Mail.
 Bewerbungen, Schulbesuche und Termine organisieren: Du koordinierst Bewerbungsunterlagen, Schulbesuche und die Vorbereitung auf Aufnahmeverfahren. Du pflegst Kundendaten sorgfältig, behältst Fristen im Blick und fasst selbstständig nach, wenn Unterlagen oder Rückmeldungen fehlen. Deine Familien wissen, welche Schritte als Nächstes anstehen.

title: Finance Intern
description:
Finance & Investor Relations Intern - Berlin
Cherry Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm founded in 2012 and based in Berlin, London and Stockholm. We are a team of former entrepreneurs and operators with experience building fast-scaling companies such as Zalando, Spotify and Uber. We have invested in over 140 companies across Europe, including Flix, Auto1, Amboss, Manual, Numa, Moss, Swap, Tacto and The Exploration Company.
We are looking for an additional team member to join as a Finance & Investor Relations Intern starting January 2027 for a period of 3-6 months .
For this role: You would need to either have an EU passport or an existing permit to work in Germany as we are unfortunately not able to sponsor visas .
 Requirements
 As part of the Finance & Investor Relations Team, you will:
 Work closely together with a dynamic team with operational and investment banking backgrounds Assist in the preparation of strategy and marketing materials for investors Assist with various investor relations activities including preparation of advisory board deck, investor calls and quarterly reporting Be involved in fund finance activities including liaising with fund administrators, lawyers and banks Contribute to building a world-class early-stage venture capital fund by taking on additional responsibilities
 Key requirements include:
 Prior experience in a start-up, VC/PE fund, consulting, or banking Strong analytical background, extremely well-versed in working with quantitative data Proficient in Microsoft Office and with AI tools Strong organisational skills Enrolled in or concluded a Master’s Degree at a top-tier university in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, similar fields or have prior experience in the sector Basic understanding of P&L, balance sheets, and cash flows You have an international and multicultural mindset/background English working proficiency

description:

 Ihre Aufgaben Unterstützung bei der Konzeption und Umsetzung von Marketingkampagnen über verschiedene Kanäle hinweg.

 Durchführung von Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen zur Optimierung unserer Positionierung.
